nodes.description: Public totalSupply state variable declared in ERC20Basic and set to INITIAL_SUPPLY in the EtherLinkToken constructor.
Mapping(address => uint256) balances in BasicToken holding token balances indexed by owner address.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed in StandardToken holding spender allowances.
Immutable constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 5000000 * 10**decimals defining the total token issuance.
Public string state variable name = 'EtherLink Token'.
Public string state variable symbol = 'ETL'.
Public uint256 state variable decimals = 18, used in the INITIAL_SUPPLY computation.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): computes c = a * b then asserts no overflow.
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b): computes c = a / b; division by zero reverts automatically.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): asserts b <= a and returns a - b.
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): computes c = a + b and asserts c >= a.
BasicToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): debits msg.sender and credits _to using SafeMath, then emits Transfer.
BasicToken.balanceOf(address _owner): constant function returning balances[_owner].
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): moves balances using the caller allowance stored in allowed[_from][msg.sender].
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender): constant function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue): adds _addedValue to the caller allowance via SafeMath.add.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue): subtracts from the caller allowance and flushes to zero if the subtracted value exceeds the old value.
EtherLinkToken constructor: sets totalSupply = INITIAL_SUPPLY and credits balances[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as balance owner and allowance owner throughout the token.
Arithmetic operation balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) inside transfer (token debit).
Arithmetic operation balances[_to].add(_value) inside transfer (token credit).
Arithmetic operation balances[_from].sub(_value) inside transferFrom (source debit).
Arithmetic operation balances[_to].add(_value) inside transferFrom (destination credit).
Arithmetic operation allowed[_from][msg.sender] = _allowance.sub(_value) inside transferFrom (allowance consumption).
Arithmetic operation allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue) inside increaseApproval.
Arithmetic operation oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue) inside decreaseApproval.
Arithmetic expression 5000000 * (10 ** uint256(decimals)) used to derive INITIAL_SUPPLY in EtherLinkToken.
